    AI Overview

    AI Mode replied:

    To get accurate car insurance quotes, compare estimates from at least three different providers using the same coverage levels, limits, and deductibles. 
    What You Need for a Quote
    • Vehicle details: Make, model, year, and mileage.
    • Personal info: Name, address, and date of birth.
    • Driver history: Traffic violations, claims, or accidents from the past three to five years.
    • Insurance history: Current or previous coverage details. 
    Where to Compare and Get Quotes
    • Check prices directly through major providers like
      Allstate or Farmers.
    • Use comparison tools to review rates side-by-side from multiple national and regional insurers.
